title: Summit of Kunlun
next_chapter_hook: The ink of destiny hovered mid-air, as Chen Ji had not yet let it fall—and in the heavens above, that pair of invisible eyes had been watching him for three full breaths. In the next instant, the Summit of Kunlun would witness the first true choice in ten thousand years.

text.content: Sword light like frost slashed down three inches before Chen Ji, forcibly splitting the transmission formation's radiance into a fissure. Ye Qing's figure stepped out from the void, the demonic path saint maiden's veil fluttering violently in the cold wind atop Kunlun's peak. Those eyes that had once conspired with Chen Ji to dominate the world now froze like ten-thousand-year-old abyssal ice. The tip of her sword trembled slightly—not from fear, but from rage. "If you activate the Kunlun seal, neither of us will exist anymore—are you certain you want to gamble everything?" Chen Ji's footsteps paused for an instant, yet he did not retreat. He raised his head, gazing at this ally who had once made a blood oath with him, and actually curved his lips into a faint smile. "Gamble?" His voice was very soft, as light as snow drifting from Kunlun's peak, "Ye Qing, how long have we known each other? When have you ever seen Chen Ji do something without certainty?"

dialogue.content: The sword light subsided, yet Ye Qing showed no intention of sheathing her weapon. She stared into Chen Ji's eyes, pronouncing each word distinctly: "Every use of the Tianji Record's fifth page, where destiny is inscribed, consumes five points of your Heavenly Fate. How much Heavenly Fate do you have left? Twenty-three points? Eighteen points?" Her voice carried an imperceptible tremor, "You think I don't know? Activating this seal will cost you at least ten points of Heavenly Fate—at which point you won't even have the ability to protect yourself!" Chen Ji offered no reply. He simply stood motionless, letting the gale atop Kunlun's peak buffet his robes wildly. After a long while, he spoke, his tone as placid as if discussing something utterly inconsequential: "Ye Qing, do you believe there is such a thing as true freedom in this world?"

text.content: Ye Qing froze. This question was far too abrupt, so sudden she momentarily lost her composure on how to respond. Freedom? She was the demonic path saint maiden, raised as a tool by the Holy Sect since childhood—no one had ever posed such a question to her. Chen Ji did not wait for her answer, directly turning to face the ancient altar standing atop Kunlun's summit. Upon the altar, golden prohibition runes coiled like chains, sealing some fathomlessly deep power within. That was the shackle of heaven's way—the final seal left by a heaven-defying figure ten thousand years ago. "The heavenly way treats all things as chess pieces," Chen Ji's voice echoed in the wind, carrying an unprecedented resolve, "It manipulates destiny, inscribes lifespans, imprisoning everyone within the rules it sets. I once believed that as long as I followed its chess game, I could find a way to break the局. Until I discovered—it has no chess game at all. It is merely rules, and rules need no chess player, because it itself is the chessboard."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's hand trembled slightly. She recalled the prophecy Chen Ji had once shown her—that future filled with blood and fire, comprehensible only to her. At that time, she had been shocked by the power of the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hands, yet never imagined this power itself was heaven's prison. "So what do you intend to do?" Her voice lowered, "Shatter the heavenly way? Do you understand what that means? What would become of heaven and earth without the binding of rules?" Chen Ji turned around, directly meeting Ye Qing's gaze. "That's why I'm asking your opinion." He said, "This isn't a war for one person alone. Ye Qing, if I shatter the heavenly way, there will be no more destiny in this universe—the trajectory of all things will be written by themselves—the cost is that there will be no more any foresight or guidance. If I become the heavenly way, this game will be played by my hand—but you know me, I despise being manipulated, so how could I be willing to manipulate others?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji halted his footsteps at the Summit of Kunlun, facing the impending choice of destiny, he needed to confirm his own path.

choices.description: Destroy all established rules, granting all things true free will, even if heaven and earth will plunge into eternal chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Tianji Record, Heavenly Fate reduced to zero
choices.visible_reward: Heaven and earth, all things freed from destiny's shackles
choices.risk_hint: A chaotic heaven and earth may be more terrifying than being controlled

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised the Tianji Record in his hand, the fragment gleaming with blinding golden light against the gale atop Kunlun's summit. He looked at Ye Qing, his gaze carrying a certain resolute tenderness: "Since the heavenly way treats us as chess pieces, I shall overturn this entire game." The Tianji Record's fifth page slowly opened, Chen Ji's hand hovering mid-air—the brush tip was only an inch from the paper's surface, yet it remained迟迟 unable to descend.

choices.description: Take the place of the old heavenly way's position, rewrite the laws of heaven and earth with one's own will, become the new master of destiny.
choices.visible_cost: Lose humanity, merge completely with the heavenly way
choices.visible_reward: Gain the power to reshape the laws of heaven and earth
choices.risk_hint: You may no longer be yourself

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, the golden text on the Tianji Record's fifth page began spinning madly. He felt an unprecedented power awakening within him—the source power of the heavenly way, the collective essence of all rules throughout ten thousand years. He slowly opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the trajectories of the entire heaven and earth. "Since the heavenly way is merely rules," his voice became ethereal and distant, "then I shall become the rules themselves."

choices.description: Neither shatter nor replace, but seek a third path—a mode of existence that transcends rules themselves.
choices.visible_cost: Unknown, may suffer heavenly way's backlash
choices.visible_reward: Break the opposition between destiny and free will
choices.risk_hint: No one has ever walked this path before

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze passed beyond Ye Qing, beyond the Summit of Kunlun, fixing directly upon that unchanging celestial dome. He suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a近乎癫狂 freedom. "Who decided this question has only two answers?" He murmured to himself, "Chess pieces, chess players, chessboard—why can't we overturn them all?" The Tianji Record quivered violently in his palm, as if sensing the wild idea deep within its master's heart.

At this moment, the heavens and earth suddenly changed color. The sky above Kunlun's peak seemed torn apart by an invisible giant hand, and a blinding white light poured from the crack, enveloping the entire altar. That light carried no warmth whatsoever, yet it brought a suffocating pressure—a manifestation of the Heavenly Dao's will, of the laws governing all things. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value rapidly draining away, and the golden characters on the fifth page of the Tianji Record began to tremble violently. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented solemnity: "It has arrived. Faster than this old man anticipated." A voice spontaneously sounded in the void, not coming from any direction but appearing directly in Chen Ji's consciousness: "Chen Ji." That voice was terrifyingly flat, devoid of any emotional波动, "You think you can break me?"

Chen Ji did not answer. He simply stood quietly in place, gazing up at the white-filled sky. The Eye of the Heavenly Dao did not appear, because what descended this time was not its eye—but its本体, the ultimate force controlling the fate of all things. Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice as calm as if chatting with an old friend: "Heavenly Dao. How many years have you imprisoned this realm? A hundred thousand? A million?" A mocking arc curved at the corner of his mouth, "You constantly preach that destiny has its predetermined course, but aren't you also afraid? Afraid that one day, someone will see through your tricks." The Heavenly Dao's voice sounded again, still without any emotion: "I am the rule. Rules do not need emotions." Chen Ji laughed, his laughter echoing across Kunlun's peak, carrying a proud air that looked down upon the world: "Don't need? Or dare not have?"

dialogue.content: Before his words even finished, two figures simultaneously appeared at the apex of Kunlun. One was the Demonic Path commander, that existence shrouded in black mist radiating a heart-stopping pressure; the other was a young woman, her features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, her eyes carrying a complex light—this was Chen Nian, Chen Ji's sister who had been missing for years, the Chen Nian taken by the Holy Sect to serve as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Two figures, one righteous and one evil, yet both appearing at this crossroads of destiny. The Demonic Path commander's voice was cold and hoarse: "Chen Ji, break the shackles of the Heavenly Dao, return this world to chaos, and this commander can give you everything you desire." Chen Nian did not speak, simply standing quietly in place, tears glistening in her eyes as she looked at her brother.

choice.prompt: The ultimate choice of destiny lay before Chen Ji. The Demonic Path commander promised power, Chen Nian's eyes held unknown secrets, and the Heavenly Dao's pressure pressed closer step by step.

choices.description: His sister's appearance touched the softest part of Chen Ji's heart. He wanted to know her experiences over these years and hear her opinion.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the optimal timing for action
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the truth and support of sister Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao will not give you much time

dialogue.content: Chen Ji walked past the Demonic Path commander and went straight toward Chen Nian. His steps were slow, each one seeming to tread upon the strings of destiny. "Niannian." His voice was somewhat hoarse; this man who always remained calm and composed before others finally showed a crack when facing his sister. Chen Nian's tears burst forth; she opened her mouth but could only produce a choked sound: "Brother... I'm sorry..." Chen Ji shook his head, reaching out to wipe the tears from her face: "I should be the one saying sorry. I didn't protect you well."

choices.description: The Demonic Path commander's proposal was too casual. Chen Ji wanted to see what scheme he was really plotting.
choices.visible_cost: May fall into the opponent's verbal trap
choices.visible_reward: See through the Demonic Path commander's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: Those of the Demonic Path never make unprofitable deals

text.content: Chen Ji did not look at Chen Nian but turned to face the Demonic Path commander. His gaze was cold as a blade, carrying a scrutinizing meaning. "The Holy Sect took Niannian back then, saying they would cultivate her into the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'" His voice was terrifyingly calm, "This lock key—what exactly is it locking?" The Demonic Path commander's laughter echoed in the void, carrying a playful tone: "Guess." Chen Ji's eyes slightly narrowed, his fingers unconsciously clenching. He suddenly realized that the true reason the Holy Sect took Chen Nian might be far more complex than he had imagined.

choices.description: Regardless of schemes or stratagems, Chen Ji wanted to directly speak with this Heavenly Dao's will and ask what it truly wanted.
choices.visible_cost: May be intimidated by the Heavenly Dao's pressure
choices.visible_reward: Directly obtain the Heavenly Dao's core secrets
choices.risk_hint: Dialoguing with the Heavenly Dao itself is a kind of risk

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly turned, facing that white light enveloping heaven and earth. His aura surged at this moment—the harmless waste disciple outer servant who appeared before others had vanished, replaced by a proud figure who dared to question heaven. "Heavenly Dao!" His voice was like thunder, "You constantly preach that destiny has its predetermined course, but your appearance today is precisely telling me—my existence has threatened you?" The white light violently trembled, and that ancient unchanging pressure actually rippled at this moment.

The Heavenly Dao's will fell silent for a moment under Chen Ji's questioning. That silence was more startling than any answer—because it meant Chen Ji was right. After a long while, that extremely flat voice sounded again: "You are merely one of the many chess pieces. A hundred thousand years ago, I personally erased an existence similar to you. He also once asked the same question." Chen Ji sneered: "So you were afraid?" The Heavenly Dao's answer came quickly: "Rules do not fear." Chen Ji shook his head, a flash of understanding in his eyes: "But you are explaining." He took a step forward, gazing directly into the depths of that white light, "A truly fearless existence needs not explain anything to anyone. Your appearance today is because you felt threatened—and your choice to appear at this moment has already proven my guess correct."

dialogue.content: At this moment, an elderly and cold laughter came from the void. Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted as he watched a familiar figure slowly walk out from the depths of the white light—an白发苍苍 old man wearing the华服 of the Tianqing Sect's Sect Master, his kind face carrying a trace of subtle ruthlessness. It was Ling Yuan, the old Sect Master who once dominated the Tianqing Sect, the hidden great enemy Chen Ji had always suspected but never caught. Ling Yuan's eyes carried a certain fanatical light: "Chen Ji, do you think you are the first person to reach this step?" His voice was hoarse and cold, "There have been no fewer than ten inheritors of the Tianji Record over ten thousand years. Each and every one once stood where you stand now, questioning the Heavenly Dao, challenging the rules—and then?" He spread open his arms, pointing toward that white light, "They all failed. And this one chose to merge with the Heavenly Dao."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Ling Yuan, a complex emotion flashing in his eyes. "So this is your choice?" His voice was very light, "Merging with the Heavenly Dao, becoming part of the rules?" A smug arc curved at the corner of Ling Yuan's mouth: "The choice a wise man should make. Becoming part of the Heavenly Dao means eternal indestructibility, sharing longevity with heaven and earth." Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that laughter carrying an inexplicable meaning. "Sharing longevity with heaven and earth?" He shook his head, "But living that way, what's the difference from being dead?" Ling Yuan's expression slightly changed: "You don't understand." Chen Ji interrupted him, his gaze passing over Ling Yuan to directly stare into the depths of that white light: "What I don't understand is you." His voice suddenly turned cold, "Ling Yuan, you constantly claim you chose to merge with the Heavenly Dao, yet your appearance today also proves you are still being commanded by the Heavenly Dao. You think you have obtained eternity, not knowing you are merely a prisoner in another form."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's appearance further complicated the situation. And Chen Nian's and the Demonic Path Commander's silence turned this crossroads of fate into an unknown tension.

choices.description: Chen Ji had long suspected something was wrong with Ling Yuan, and now he seized the opportunity to expose his true face, forcing him to reveal his original form before the world.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming time may allow Heavenly Dao to take advantage
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's reputation ruined, truth revealed
choices.risk_hint: Beware of a cornered beast desperate action

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that laughter echoing across Kunlun's summit, carrying a chilling mockery. "Ling Yuan, you claim repeatedly that you chose to merge with Heavenly Dao—but how do I recall that on the Tianji Record's inheritance candidate list, you were actually the first in line?" Ling Yuan's face changed drastically. "The Tianji Record chose me itself, not you." Chen Ji's voice came out word by word, "What you hate isn't Heavenly Dao, it's that the Tianji Record didn't choose you. You're standing here today not because you merged with Heavenly Dao, but because you want to use Heavenly Dao's hand to reclaim what was originally yours!"

choices.text: Form alliance with Demonic Path Commander
choices.description: The enemy of my enemy is my friend. Chen Ji decided to temporarily ally with the Demonic Path Commander to first solve this common major enemy.
choices.visible_cost: May be viewed as Demonic Path accomplice
choices.visible_reward: Gain powerful ally, Heavenly Dao faces pincer attack
choices.risk_hint: Can the Demonic Path people be trusted?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to the Demonic Path Commander, his gaze carrying scrutiny. "You say breaking Heavenly Dao's shackles will return the world to chaos—and what comes after chaos?" The Demonic Path Commander's laughter echoed through the void: "After chaos comes new order. And both you and I will become the architects of this new order." Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly extended his hand: "Let's deal with the trouble at hand first." The Demonic Path Commander was stunned, then burst into laughter, clapping hands with Chen Ji as a vow. Ye Qing's expression turned extremely ugly—she wanted to stop them, but it was already too late.

choices.description: Chen Nian is the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," her existence can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. Chen Ji decided to awaken the sleeping power within her.
choices.visible_reward: Gain new means to counter Heavenly Dao

dialogue.content: Chen Ji walked toward Chen Nian, reaching out to grasp her hand. "Nian Nian, you're the Heavenly Fate Lock Key." His voice was very soft, "The Holy Sect took you not because they wanted to control you, but because your existence itself is the key to counter Heavenly Dao." Chen Nian looked up, her eyes filled with tears and confusion: "Brother, I don't understand..." Chen Ji smiled faintly: "You don't need to understand. You only need to do one thing—trust me." His hand clasped hers, fingers interlaced, a gentle yet firm power flowing from his palm into Chen Nian's body.

text.content: Heavenly Dao's will seemed to sense something, and that white light began to churn violently. Ling Yuan's expression changed drastically, he instinctively stepped back—for he felt fear coming from Heavenly Dao's本体. "Impossible..." Ling Yuan's voice began to tremble, "How could Heavenly Dao feel fear... it's just the rules... it shouldn't have emotions..." Chen Ji coldly glanced at him: "Rules are dead, but the being that creates rules is alive. You've merged with it for so long, haven't you discovered yet? It's not the rules themselves, it's merely the guardian of the rules—and a guardian, after enough time, will develop its own will." At this moment, Heavenly Dao's white light completely lost control, that ancient unchanging pressure actually began to show cracks. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying rare praise: "Kid, you've gone further than this old man anticipated."

Chen Ji slowly raised the Tianji Record in his hand. The golden characters on the fragment at this moment radiated unprecedented light—that was the sign of all ten pages' power converging. Mo Xiansheng's figure emerged from the fragment, an old and illusory existence, his gaze passing over Chen Ji, over Ling Yuan, over the Demonic Path Commander, straight to that crumbling white light. "Ten thousand years." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of vicissitude, "This old man waited a full ten thousand years, finally waiting for someone who could walk this far." He turned to Chen Ji, his eyes carrying a complex light, "Chen Ji, do you know the true purpose of the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji shook his head. Mo Xiansheng smiled, that smile carrying a kind of relief: "The Tianji Record isn't meant to foresee destiny. It's meant to write destiny."

Mo Xiansheng's figure began to fade, as if it might dissipate at any moment. "Each page of the Tianji Record seals a kind of destiny's power. The first page is memory, the second is foresight, the third is deduction, the fourth is rewriting..." his voice grew increasingly weak, "And the fifth page is ending." Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. "Ending?" Mo Xiansheng nodded: "End the old destiny, write a new future." His figure had already faded to nearly invisible, "Chen Ji, this old man has taught you everything he can. The next step, you must walk alone." His gaze fell on Chen Nian, carrying a hint of tenderness, "Also, protect her well. She's not just the Heavenly Fate Lock Key... she's your only blood relative in this world." As his words fell, Mo Xiansheng's figure completely dissipated, turning into golden motes that merged into the Tianji Record.

Chen Ji held the Tianji Record, feeling the power surging from the fragment. Heavenly Dao's will was frantically counterattacking, countless chain-like runes appearing in the white light, attempting to imprison both Chen Ji and Chen Nian simultaneously. Ling Yuan took advantage of the chaos to lunge at Chen Ji, his eyes burning with madness: "The Tianji Record is mine! I discovered it first!" Chen Ji didn't look back, only speaking calmly: "Ye Qing." In the next instant, a sharp sword light slashed down from the void, forcing Ling Yuan back dozens of zhang. Ye Qing's figure appeared at Chen Ji's side, the demonic saint's sword still carrying ice-cold radiance. "You said you'd help me." Chen Ji's voice was very soft, "Now, help me hold him off." Ye Qing said nothing, only gave a slight nod, then turned to face Ling Yuan.

Chen Ji held the Tianji Record, walking step by step toward the altar's center. The sealing restrictions parted automatically as he approached, as if welcoming their true master. The Demonic Path Commander stood not far away, his gaze carrying scrutiny but making no move to obstruct. Chen Nian followed behind him, the siblings walking side by side, facing that nearly mad white light. "Chen Ji!" Heavenly Dao's will's voice carried emotion for the first time—a fury bordering on fear, "If you dare break these rules, this heaven and earth will be forever plunged into chaos!" Chen Ji stopped, looking up at that white light. "Chaos?" A faint smile curved his lips, "You think you can frighten me with the word 'chaos'?"

Chen Ji opened the Tianji Record's fifth page, a blank sheet of paper yet containing power sufficient to change heaven and earth. He lifted the pen, the tip hovering above the paper's surface, only a thread's distance from touching down. "I will not be a piece, nor will I be a chess player—" his voice echoed across Kunlun's summit, carrying unprecedented resolve and freedom, "—I will overturn this entire game." As his words fell, his gaze swept across everyone present—Ye Qing was locked in fierce battle with Ling Yuan, Chen Nian gazed at him with tears, the Demonic Path Commander watched coldly, Heavenly Dao's will howled madly. "This stroke, no matter where it falls, will change the destiny of heaven and earth." His voice became low, "So I want to ask—what kind of future do you want?"

No one answered. Perhaps it was too late to answer, or perhaps they weren't qualified to. Chen Ji smiled, that smile carrying a kind of lonely acceptance. "Forget it." he said softly, "This path was always destined to be walked alone." The brush tip finally touched the paper, golden ink beginning to spread across the fifth page. But just at this moment, a voice suddenly rang out, interrupting Chen Ji's motion. "Wait!" It was Chen Nian's voice, carrying a sob yet undeniably firm. Chen Ji's hand froze. He turned his head, looking at his sister. Chen Nian rushed forward, grabbing the hand that held the brush: "Brother, you said you would protect me." Her tears fell onto the Tianji Record, yet they weren't absorbed by the paper surface. Instead, they transformed into dots of light, merging into the brush. "Then you must promise me too—no matter what you write, you must survive." The ink of fate hung suspended mid-air, Chen Ji had yet to write that stroke—and above the heavens, that invisible gaze had been watching him for three full breaths. In the next instant, the summit of Kunlun would witness the first true choice in ten thousand years.
